{{Quote|Honor, right. How's that working out now?|Mandalorian mercenary mocking Jaing for leaving Ung Kusp due to the latter's lack of honor.|<ref name="Prot" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] of a [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Ung Kusp)|clan]] loyal to [[Ung Kusp]].<ref name="Prot" />

Many centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWEN">{{CSWECite|II|394|Nubyl}}</ref> the Mandalorian was among a group of mercenaries sent to an industrial wasteland in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to recover a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor's cane|artifact]] stolen by an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Unidentified Outer Rim cyberneticist|doctor]]. After breaching the door of the doctor's [[Cyborg science center|facility]], the group encountered Master [[Jaing]],<ref name="Prot" /> a former [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and enemy of Kusp,<ref name="CSWEJ">{{CSWECite|II|135|Jaing, Master}}</ref> along with his protegé, [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], and [[Nubyl]], all beneficiaries of the doctor's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements, who inflicted heavy casualties on the Mandalorians, but were dispatched by the explosion of a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. This Mandalorian recovered the artifact, and stood over an injured Jaing, mocking him for his dedication to honor and threatening to behead him, only to be caught by surprise and disemboweled on Jaing's horns.<ref name="Prot" />

However, the Mandalorian's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] discharged, dealing Jaing a mortal wound and motivating Durge to drive the group off and swear revenge against against the Mandalorians. In reality, the attack was orchestrated by the doctor in a plot to start a war between the Mandalorians and the Sith.<ref name="Prot" />
